simple.summary: חָשִׂף (châsiph) means properly, drawn off , i.e. separated ; hence, a small company (as divided from the rest) First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 20 27.

definitions.short: properly, drawn off , i.e. separated ; hence, a small company (as divided from the rest)
definitions.full: H2835. chasiph [ חָשִׂיף ] noun masculine only plural construct עִזִּים חֲשִׂפֵי כִּשְׁנֵי 1Kin 20:27 ᵑ7 ᵑ9 ᵐ5 and most, two little flocks of goats ( חשׂיף = segregatum , strictly what is stripped off ), but this without other evidence than authority of the Vrss; Klo proposes עִזִּים מִשְׁמַּט בַּשְּׁפִי on the bare height, after the manner of goats .
